examples.input:
The following observations were collected during experimentation on an aqueous sample:
- The sample solution is colorless.
- When concentrated HCl is added to the sample solution, no precipitate forms.
- Then H2S gas is bubbled through the resulting acidic solution; a black precipitate forms.
- After filtering the black precipitate, addition of 2 mL (NH4)2S 0.5 M to 1 mL of the filtrate (solution X) does not cause any precipitations.
- Addition of excess NaHCO3 to solution X, causes a white precipitate to form.
- After filtering this white precipitate, the filtrate gives a red flame test.
- The white precipitate from NaHCO3, dissolves in dilute HNO3 resulting in a solution that also gives a red flame test.

Assuming that all of the above statements are true, which of the following options is correct?
